title: The Forgotten Crown
premise: Vesper Dunmore has spent years charting the Thornfell mountains, hiding the gift that lets her feel the land's hidden paths. When the crown declares war on all gift-bearers, she flees with a hunted scholar, Cael, who reveals the gift was once the binding thread of a covenant between the human realm and the forgotten realm of Thornfell's original people. To survive, Vesper must reforge that broken covenant at the mountain's heart — but the price is her own identity, for the land demands a keeper who belongs wholly to it. In the end, Vesper surrenders her name and memory to become the new covenant, sparing both realms and leaving Cael to carry her maps, and her story, back to the world.
about_author: Xanthe Kavanagh is a former trail guide who spent a decade mapping remote highland passes before turning to fiction. She writes fantasy rooted in landscapes, borders, and the people who slip between them.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Secret
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. She finishes a commission in the smuggler town of Greyhollow, concealing the gift that lets her sense unmapped ways through the Thornfells. When crown soldiers burn a gift-bearer's cottage in the market square, Vesper realizes the hunt has reached her. The emotional beat is quiet dread — the life she built is already ash.

chapters.title: Smoke on the Pass
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. Fleeing through a pass only her gift could find, she stumbles on Cael, a wounded scholar carrying a stolen royal decree and a shattered covenant-stone. Pursued by a ruthless hunter-captain, Maren Voss, Vesper must use her gift openly for the first time. The beat: reluctant alliance born of shared desperation.

chapters.title: What the Mountains Remember
chapters.summary: Cael's POV. He explains the covenant: the gift-bearers were once oath-keepers who bound the realms together, betrayed and scattered generations ago. Vesper refuses to believe she's part of anything so grand. Crossing into the deep Thornfells, the land itself begins responding to her. The beat: wonder curdling into fear of what she is.

chapters.title: The Toll of Roads
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. The land demands payment for each hidden path they take — warmth, memory, blood. Vesper pays with a childhood memory and begins to suspect the covenant's price was always this. Maren's hunters close in; a village that shelters them is punished for it. The beat: guilt — survival has a cost, and others are paying it.

chapters.title: The Hollow Court
chapters.summary: Cael's POV. They reach the last gift-bearer enclave, a hidden settlement led by the matriarch Sable, who tests Vesper and finds her gift dangerously strong — and dangerously untrained. Sable offers sanctuary but demands Vesper renounce the human realm. Vesper, who never belonged anywhere, must choose which belonging is real. The beat: identity as a fork in the road.

chapters.title: Betrayal in Green Light
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. Maren Voss breaches the enclave using knowledge only an insider could hold — Cael's decree was bait all along, and his order wants the covenant reforged under crown control. The enclave burns. Sable dies buying Vesper time, naming her the last possible keeper. The beat: rage and the collapse of every safe harbor.

chapters.title: The Long Descent
chapters.summary: Cael's POV. Hunted and grieving, Vesper and Cael descend toward the mountain's heart, where the original covenant was sworn. Vesper's gift now pulls memory from her faster than she can spare it — she is forgetting her mother's face, her own name's origin. The beat: the terrible intimacy of a price already being paid.

chapters.title: Where the Crown Breaks
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. Maren corners them at the threshold of the deep place, but the land rises against her — she is a daughter of Thornfell's scattered people without knowing it, and the mountain offers her the choice Vesper faces. Maren, broken by the revelation, stands down. The beat: the hunter unmasked as kin; vengeance dissolved into grief.

chapters.title: The Reforging
chapters.summary: Vesper and Cael's alternating POV. At the covenant-heart, the land makes its demand: a keeper who surrenders name, memory, and the human world entire. Cael begs her to refuse; Vesper understands at last that belonging was never something she could take — only give. She swears the covenant. The beat: sacrifice as the truest form of homecoming.

chapters.title: Maps of What Remains
chapters.summary: Cael's POV, epilogue. The realms are bound again; gift-bearers are safe, though none remember why. Cael publishes Vesper's maps under her name, the only monument she'd have wanted. In the deep Thornfells, a presence watches travelers kindly and knows every smuggler's road. The beat: mourning transformed into legacy — she is gone, and she is everywhere.
